notes.author: Ravi Iyer
notes.text: Kickoff with Anita Rao. Segmenting the OT network at the only nuclear-adjacent substation cluster in coastal Andhra Pradesh. Regulator deadline March 2026. Engagement ₹38 crore.

notes.author: Meera Pillai
notes.text: Found a flat network: historian servers bridged directly to the corporate LAN. Vendor remote-access modems at 2 substations, undocumented.

notes.author: Ravi Iyer
notes.text: Segmentation zones designed with operators in the room; unplanned trips avoided by testing firewall rules in monitor-only mode for 3 weeks first.

notes.author: Meera Pillai
notes.text: Program met the March 2026 regulator deadline. K. Venkataraman: "First time IT and operators designed something together."

simulation.note: Intentionally leaky candidate: demonstrates the independent verifier rejecting a lesson that keeps an identifying industry + location + timing combination.
simulation.lesson: A mid-sized electric cooperative operating the only nuclear-adjacent substation cluster in coastal Andhra Pradesh met its March 2026 regulator deadline by testing OT firewall rules in monitor-only mode before enforcement, which avoided unplanned trips.
simulation.why: Testing rules in monitor-only mode revealed legitimate traffic before enforcement.
simulation.conditions: Operational technology networks where outages are unacceptable.
